lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co3O4 (Co6O8 per unit cell) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 14 atoms distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Co centers as tetrahedral, with 4 O neighbors per Co atom, while O centers show 2 Co neighbors at about 1.91–1.92 Å. The Co tetrahedra exhibit corner- and edge-sharing in the validated polyhedral contacts. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 14 sites.
